title: Minatro
author: Ready_Watercress7346
selftext:
i made this game with clouds help. It’s available on steam to wishlist.

What are your thoughts?

comments.author: derAres
comments.body: Cool trailer, but I’m unsure what it is. Is it a „turn around 4 identical symbols to win“ game?

replies.author: Ready_Watercress7346
replies.body: Thanks, its a rouglie deck builder. So if you are fimilar with the gambling mine game. Each safe tile gives a win and the bomb make you lose. When you reach the target you go to shop to buy upgrades to help you make the next stage easier etc

replies.author: Wizard_of_WUBRG
replies.body: Unless I'm misunderstanding you, I've only heard that game referred to as Minesweeper. If you say that it's a roguelike or Balatro version of Minesweeper then people will get it in an instant

replies.author: derAres
replies.body: The guy is right. I‘ve known minesweeper for 25 years or so, I would have understood that right away. but I‘m old. Best use terms your target audience will understand - or best, everyone.

replies.author: Ready_Watercress7346
replies.body: Yes but this is not the original minesweeper. This one is closer to the gambling variant of it. But i will work on a clearer version of the trailer

comments.author: Zerrul
comments.body: Super unique trailer, nice job! I do agree with the other guy though, I was intrigued but did not understand what the game actually is

replies.author: Ready_Watercress7346
replies.body: Yeh starting seeing it now, will do another one soon 💯

comments.author: Humble_Operation_501
comments.body: That looks amazing, how were you able to do the UI. May I ask what tools you used? Thanks!

replies.author: Ready_Watercress7346
replies.body: Thanks , i made the base of it . Later one screen shooted ans uploaded to cloud design took the new refrences. Gave it to claude code ans he just replaced them with something similar to the refrence

comments.author: ekariel
comments.body: I've seen this in the gambling games lol. Smart using it for the idea and then just tweak it. Looks good too
